article.title: Act not in derogation of any other law.
article.content: The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to and not in derogation of the provisions of any other law for the time being in force.
article.html:

Section 100 · Chapter VIII · page 35 of the Act

The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to and not in derogation of the provisions of any other law for the time being in force.
